item.title: [github_trending] bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
item.description: God's Eye View is an open source browser app that renders a photorealistic 3D globe layered with live aircraft, ships, satellite, earthquake, traffic and public camera data, plus hands-free voice control driven by a realtime AI agent. Built by bilawalsidhu, the developer behind the YouTube series of the same name (formerly WorldView), it reached #1 on GitHub Trending. It suits developers working on geospatial visualization and real-time data feeds.

item.description: Anysite.io is a Product Hunt tool that builds and enriches B2B prospect lists by chatting with an agent, so you describe the accounts you want instead of filling in spreadsheets by hand. It targets sales and growth teams doing outbound prospecting who need company and contact data assembled quickly.

item.title: [juejin] Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受

Useful for developers weighing the two tools.

item.title: [v2ex] [问与答] Windows 内存占用的问题，任务管理器 vs 资源管理器 显示不一样？
item.description: A V2EX user with 32GB of RAM sees Task Manager report 86% memory usage (about 27GB), yet adding up the processes it lists falls far short of that figure, while Resource Monitor shows only 35% of physical memory in use. He posted three screenshots asking why the two Windows tools disagree on the same machine.

item.title: [infoq] AI Coding 的下一步不是写得更快，而是可验收：蚂蚁数科 Harness 工程实践
item.description: At AICon, Ant Digital Technologies expert Wei Changzheng described a "Harness" engineering approach: a 400k-line Rust project had Harness built into its workflow from day one, while a 600k-line legacy C++ project first rebuilt its source of truth and quality gates before agents were allowed to upgrade the repo, cutting defect rates from over 20% to single digits. His argument: verifiability, not speed, is AI coding's next step.

item.title: [v2ex] [Claude] [推广] QuietDog API｜ CCMax、Kiro 号池中转，倍率分别为 0.5 / 0.25

item.title: [infoq] 怒斥加密货币是旁氏骗局、放弃80%就业机会也不用 AI 写代码！Kotlin“J神”：AI 会让工程师变成可替换的齿轮
item.description: Jake Wharton, a well-known Android and Kotlin open source developer, has listed nine criteria for his next job, starting with a refusal to join AI companies, work on AI-centric products, or accept mandatory AI tooling — a rule he estimates rules out roughly 80% of employers. He says he has never used an AI agent to write code, arguing AI can handle repetitive work but that generating code beyond a developer's ability to understand and maintain is the most irresponsible use.

item.title: [infoq] AI 有了“工号”，数据平台长出了手：我在 Snowflake World Tour 看到的三个变化
item.description: Writing up Snowflake World Tour Shanghai, the author draws three takeaways from global product president Christian Kleinerman's keynote: agents now get Agent Identity and Policy, effectively an employee ID capping what they can read, write, move and spend; data platforms are starting to take action rather than just answer queries; and Snowflake is embracing open source. Aimed at data and AI practitioners tracking enterprise agent adoption.

item.title: [infoq] AI Coding 提速之后，如何补上稳定性“最后一公里”？快手柯南 AI 实践
item.description: Wang Zefeng, a stability engineer at Kuaishou, presented the company's 'Conan AI' work at AICon Shanghai: deterministic steps go to code, probabilistic reasoning to models, with expert experience captured as Skills and bad cases driving iteration. The system has reached nearly 60% adoption among Kuaishou's front-end R&D staff, with about 50% full adoption of its root-cause analyses, and located a pure system-stack Use-After-Free issue behind a HarmonyOS C++ crash in roughly 10 minutes.

item.description: HashiCorp released Packer v1.16.0, adding a provenance post-processor that generates, signs and verifies SLSA Provenance v1 in-toto attestations for every machine image, capturing the Git commit, branch, CI pipeline and build timestamp. It supports four signing modes — unsigned JSON, local PEM keys, cloud KMS or Vault, and keyless Sigstore Fulcio with Rekor — plus a reference GitHub Actions workflow mapping to SLSA build levels L1–L3, aimed at teams doing image supply-chain audits and deploy gat

item.title: [infoq] Netflix 采用开源 Flink Autoscaler，支撑超 3 万个流式作业
item.description: Netflix is moving more than 30,000 streaming jobs onto the open-source Apache Flink Autoscaler across multiple AWS regions. Its earlier cluster-level autoscaler was too coarse for pipelines with branches, joins and terabytes of state, so the new per-operator approach described in FLIP-271 estimates parallelism from throughput and busy time; one team cut its Flink compute spend by 58% annualized, about $1.1M a year.

item.title: [github_trending] debpalash/VoiceStudio
item.description: VoiceStudio is a fully local, open-source voice toolkit (formerly OmniVoice-Studio) bundling 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines for voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation, transcription and audiobook creation across 646 languages on macOS, Windows, Linux and Docker. The local workflow needs no account, API key or subscription, which suits developers who want self-hosted speech tooling without a usage meter. An Electron rewrite is underway, and desktop-app issues and PRs are on hold.

item.description: colibri is a pure-C, dependency-free inference engine that treats disk, RAM and VRAM as one memory hierarchy and streams experts from disk, letting frontier MoE models of 744B to 2.8T parameters run on consumer or heterogeneous hardware. Nine model families are supported today, including GLM, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4. It targets developers who want to serve very large MoE models on machines they already own.

item.title: [github_trending] multimodal-art-projection/YuE
item.description: YuE2 is a music generation model from the multimodal-art-projection team that unifies symbolic planning with audio generation, and adds zero-shot covers plus agentic music editing; weights ship as YuE2-3B on Hugging Face. item.title: [github_trending] jiji262/douyin-downloader
item.description: jiji262/douyin-downloader is a Douyin batch download tool that handles both single items and whole author profiles, pulling videos, image galleries, collections and original audio with watermarks stripped out. It bundles progress display, retries, SQLite-based deduplication and a browser fallback, aimed at people archiving large volumes of clips.

item.title: [github_trending] melgarafael/DeskcommCRM
item.description: DeskcommCRM is a self-hosted, open-source CRM that wires native AI agents and a WhatsApp channel (via WAHA) directly into the sales pipeline, positioned as an open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk and Intercom. It's built on Next.js 16, TypeScript and Supabase, and ships MCP support, multi-tenancy and LGPD compliance — aimed at teams that sell over chat and want their data on their own servers.
